segments.text:
THe corruption, which in this petition we ought to mourne for, is the cō
tinuall rebellion of our wicked natures; and our pronenesse to yeeld vp our selues in euery temptation to sinne & Satan. And the remnants of the old bondage vnder Satan must be grieuous and irkesome vnto vs, and wee must bewaile them bitterly. The Iewes in a bodily captiuitie, wept when they remembred Sion. Psal. 1.27. How much more should wee weepe, when wee feele the lawe of our members rebelling against the lawe of our mindes, and leading v• captiue to sinne.
